title: Fog lights and preferred prior features
summary: Feedback in this topic is mostly about customers wanting fog lights or comparing current features with preferred elements from prior vehicles, with the sample also mixing in unrelated preference comments.

positive.summary: One positive review praises a previous vehicle’s overall size as preferable to the current one.

negative.summary: One negative review explicitly expresses disappointment that fog lights are no longer included.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mainly mention requests or preferences for front or rear fog lights, plus one note that redesigned headlights were intended to replace separate fog lights.

limitations: The sampled fragments mix fog-light requests with unrelated comparisons about vehicle size and door handles, so the topic is not fully coherent.
Most examples are undetermined preference statements, which limits clear interpretation of sentiment beyond stated requests.
There are too few explicit sentiment examples to support broader conclusions about customer satisfaction with lighting features.
